scope: Proposition 6.3 (Exact compensation and spin offsets) of the manuscript “BKT universality for height and planar spin fields” (preprints/BKT-universality-for-height-and-planar-spin-fields-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 216 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5e6a8df09e021c4a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 85. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The normalized integral with inverse co- variance Equation (6.6), vertex factors, edge factors fb(w), and factor eU(w,p) equals Equation (6.3) up to one source-independent determinant normalization. If in the interaction one replaces p 7→ p + η, ψ 7→ ψ + ϑ, w 7→ w − idcη/µ, (6.7) including this last replacement in fb, the integral is the physical inserted partition function multiplied by exp{(s + d2 c/µ)∥η∥2 /2}. (6.8) These identities have the finite-dimensional limiting interpretation specified in the proof, including at s = 0.
